name: Sommelgeist
ability: Aged Vintage / Cursed Body / Magic Bounce (hidden)
look: a spectral connoisseur in a tattered tuxedo and burgundy bow tie with a swirling wine cape and a ghostly wisp tail
entry: Sommelgeist haunts centuries-old underground cellars, judging the quality of buried casks and guarding rare vintages from thieves.
how: Wild: rare, at night, in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
Its ability Aged Vintage raises a random stat at the end of every turn it stays in battle.
